title: The top of Home
question: Three ways to turn today's lyric into a small daily moment, tied to the song, with no blurred banner. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: A postcard from your library
options.lineage: Photo postcards and the notes written on their backs
options.thesis: Each day your library sends you a card: the song's art on the front, the lyric as its message.
materials: crisp album art or artist photo, framed
the lyric set as the card's message
a date mark in the artist's colour
options.viewport: Wordmark row on top; below, one wide card: the artwork framed on its left, the lyric and the song beside it, today's date stamped in the artist's colour; the pin sits on the card. Today's pick starts right under it.
options.risk: If it leans into stamps and paper it becomes a costume; it has to stay a clean card in Home's own type.

raised.raise: Click the card and it turns over: the back is your story with the song (first played, how often, album, year, quality).
It settles in each morning with a slight tilt that levels out, and the date mark is new every day.

options.label: The artist's colour, with them standing in it
options.lineage: Gig posters and album-era press portraits
options.thesis: The top becomes a field of the artist's own colour, with the artist cut out and standing in it.
materials: a wide field of the sampled colour
the artist photo cut out with a real matte (macOS person segmentation)
the album cover as a small chip
options.viewport: A rounded field of the artist's colour runs the width; the lyric sits large on its left, the song and its story beneath; the cut-out artist stands on the right, breaking the field's top edge; the wordmark sits above the field.
options.risk: Needs a photo of a person to cut out; bands' logos, groups and illustrations fall back to the album cover standing in the field.

raised.raise: The field's colour drifts slowly between the two to four hues sampled from the artist, so the top is never quite the same twice.
The portrait sits a little behind the scroll, a slow parallax as Home moves under it.

options.label: The day's CD, opened
options.lineage: The CD rack's own jewel case and its booklet
options.thesis: The song's album rests on Home as the same clear case from your rack, opened to a booklet page with the lyric printed on it.
materials: the rack's 3D jewel case, slightly open
the lyric printed on the booklet in the spine's designed face
the song's story set as the tray card's credits
options.viewport: Wordmark row on top; on the left the opened case at about 240pt, cover on one side and the booklet page with the lyric on the other; on the right the song, artist, pin and its story as credits; the shelves start below.
options.risk: A 3D object is heavy at the top of a page; it has to stay small and render cheaply to feel like a moment, not a centrepiece.

raised.raise: The case eases open as Home appears and the disc turns a quarter, the same motion language as taking a CD out of the rack.
It tilts slightly under the pointer, catching the light like the Clear Case Look.
